title: remix3-local-rag-agent: a minimal retrieval-augmented generation pipeline running on a local machine
description:
Proof of concept of the basic elements of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), all of them local: no cloud service and no API key. A Remix 3 page draws the pipeline as a diagram next to a chat where the same question can be asked three ways — a plain large language model, RAG over a Wikipedia article, and an agent — to see what each one adds. Inference runs on Ollama and vectors are stored in Qdrant. The embedding step and the chat UI are written by hand, without a framework, so that the code shows how those components work.

The write-up, with the six components, the time measured for each stage on a 2016 laptop and the limits observed, is at https://migueldiazmacedo.com/laboratorio/rag-minimo-local/.

The software is MIT-licensed. The text in data/rag-wikipedia.md comes from Wikipedia and stays under CC BY-SA 4.0; see data/NOTICE.md.
